notes.title: Special Promotion! 50% off Bunny Must Die!, Gundemonium Recollection, Hitogata Happa and GundeadliGne!
notes.notes: Thanks again to everyone for their support and understanding! Many have asked us, will there be a discount before the games are retired? Because everyone asked so nicely, we made a special arrangement with the developer. The following games will be on SALE (50% off) until July 31st, 2019; Bunny Must Die!, Gundemonium Recollection, Hitogata Happa and GundeadliGne! Thanks again.

notes.title: On more thing about Bunny Must Die! retiring from Steam on July 31st, 2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, just wanted to clarify a few things about the games we’re retiring on July 31st, Bunny Must Die!, Gundemonium Recollection, GundeadGline and Hitogata Happa. 

1.  As long as Steam is around, you can always re-download the games to your library.

2. There will be no further updates to the games. 

Thank you for understanding.  

Sincerely yours,
Rockin’ Android Team

notes.title: Bunny Must Die! will be retired from Steam on July 31st, 2019
notes.notes:
Greetings Androids! We have a bit of sad news today, the following Rockin’ Android games will be retired from Steam store on July 31st, 2019; Bunny Must Die!, Gundemonium Recollection, GundeadGline and Hitogata Happa. We are sorry for the inconvenience, the original developer Platine Dispositif has decided to retire the games; with the intention to update and publish them on Steam at a later date. Please contact them directly for more details. Also the retired games will no longer be updated. The decision to retire the games was not ours, but we respect their decision and we thank Platine Dispositif for granting us permission to publish their games and to add our own spin, such as the popular remix soundtracks. It has been an absolute blast working on these games and we’re extremely grateful to the fans, programmers, translators and specially Platine Dispositif for all their wonderful support! Thank you all!! 

Sincerely yours,
Rockin’ Android Team

notes.title: Bunny Must Die! is now fully compatible with Windows 10.
notes.notes: A huge thanks to the fans for your support and patience, Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils is now fully compatible with Windows 10. The update also includes minor bug fixes and performance improvements. Thank you for playing and enjoying Rockin’ Android games.

notes.title: Bunny Must Die project in development with WayForward is officially cancelled.
notes.notes: Our sincere apologies, Rockin’ Android is committed to bringing you the best in independently produced Japanese gaming; however the Bunny Must Die project in development with WayForward has officially been cancelled. Stay tuned for further announcements on upcoming Rockin’ Android games and updates.

notes.title: Rockin' Android and WayForward are teaming up!
notes.notes: With our powers combined, we will be bringing Bunny Must Die to PS4 and Xbox One. Check out the full announcement [url=http://www.rockinandroid.com/news/latest-news/news.php?id=rockinandroid_wayforward_bunnymustdie]here[/url]!

notes.title: Now Available - Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils
notes.notes:
Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils is Now Available on Steam at 10% off!*

From the creator of the Gundemonium Collection comes a thrilling new 2D action-platformer!

Help Bunny escape the Devils’ Labyrinth and defeat the 7 Devils in this hilariously over-the-top action-platformer game. Battle through a large, connected map filled with unique enemies, traps, and puzzles. Use magical items like the Sylph Shooter and the Hyper Heels to power up and defeat the 7 Devils. Manipulate the fabric of time to solve puzzles and survive. Will Bunny be rid of those new ears she so despises? Only with your assistance can she brave this dangerous maze...

*Offer ends October 3rd at 10AM Pacific Time
